classification_terms.engine: Current package is a Phase 0 engine candidate.
classification_terms.app: Current package is an application interface or composition candidate.
classification_terms.connector: A future optional adapter package outside the current top-level inventory.
classification_terms.hosted: A future managed-service package outside the current top-level inventory.
classification_terms.mixed: Current package contains more than one target ownership scope and is not exempt from Phase 1 extraction.
classification_terms.legacy: Current package is predecessor, migration, or parity work that shipping namespaces must not require.
classification_terms.workspace: Current package is repository tooling and must not become a runtime dependency.

capture.current_scope: Durable capture, provenance, queues, and deterministic extraction share paths with source-specific media and provider coupling.
capture.phase_1_action: Separate the common capture envelope and deterministic workflow from source-specific adapters.

cli.current_scope: Parser and terminal representation currently also construct adapters.
cli.phase_1_action: Split parsing and representation from composition.

core.current_scope: Values, policies, identifiers, and ports form the current protected engine scope.
core.phase_1_action: Add the v0 identities and public surface without exposing every port.

dev.phase_1_action: Keep out of runtime dependency graphs and native artifacts.

events.current_scope: Durable event values and occurrence-time behavior.
events.phase_1_action: Keep persistence with the workflow that owns it.

integrations.current_scope: Retrieval, UI and MCP representation, and external-system behavior share one package.
integrations.phase_1_action: Separate retrieval, representations, and external normalizers by capability.

ledger.current_scope: Knowledge, publication, receipts, and writer rules.
ledger.phase_1_action: Retain unless the vertical slice proves a clearer knowledge/publication module.

migrate.phase_1_action: Retain only reviewed generic public importers in a shipping artifact.

operations.current_scope: Maintenance sits beside cutover, shadow, predecessor parity, and connector jobs.
operations.phase_1_action: Extract by capability; do not rename the package wholesale.

parity.phase_1_action: Keep outside app and release-acceptance dependencies.

portable.current_scope: Portable v1 strict serialization and versioned interchange contracts.
portable.phase_1_action: Keep runtime import and export orchestration behind this public contract.

production.current_scope: Canonical adapters, provider and daemon runtime, and source bridges are coupled.
production.phase_1_action: Split local adapters, runtime adapters, and source bridges by owner.

providers.current_scope: Provider port and deterministic behavior sit beside local HTTP and cloud implementations.
providers.phase_1_action: Keep the port and none behavior with engine; move transport implementations by owner.

release.current_scope: Installation lifecycle, replacement evidence, and artifact auditing are coupled.
release.phase_1_action: Separate native lifecycle, legacy stabilization, and artifact conformance work.

review.current_scope: Proposal and decision behavior with durable review receipts.
review.phase_1_action: Add independently decided sibling proposals; move UI and CLI representations to app.

services.current_scope: HTTP, UI, MCP process entry points, and composition roots.
services.phase_1_action: Fold surfaces and composition into the app-owned boundary.

storage.target_owner: engine local implementation and app adapters
storage.current_scope: Local persistence imports operations lock types, so the package cannot yet be treated as an isolated engine adapter.
storage.phase_1_action: Move lock identity out of operations before extracting local adapters.

__init__.current_scope: Package version and deliberately exported public values.
__init__.phase_1_action: Keep the public surface explicit and small.

__main__.phase_1_action: Keep with the app distribution entry point.

config.current_scope: Private-deployment settings currently import ledger models.
config.phase_1_action: Compile one Brain root without importing ledger models.

dynamic_import_sites.reason: Loads one configured adapter through the explicit integration boundary.
Loads the selected provider adapter after closed provider-policy checks.
Lazily imports the optional external OpenAI dependency after cloud authority checks.

rules.rationale: The current protected engine scope must not depend on application interfaces, optional connectors, hosted code, legacy behavior, or workspace tooling.
